> **Required package:** [`Dapper.FluentMap`](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Dapper.FluentMap)

## Problem solved

Materialize a constructor-based aggregate with mapped columns.

## When to use it

Use this capability when the column shape and .NET model should remain separated by explicit, reviewable configuration.

## Example

```csharp
public sealed class Customer
{
    public Customer(int id, string name)
    {
        Id = id;
        Name = name;
    }

    public int Id { get; }
    public string Name { get; }
}

var customer = connection.QueryMappedSingle<Customer>(sql);
```

## How it works

FluentMap registers typed metadata and applies it through the matching materialization path. SQL, connections, parameters, and lifecycle remain responsibilities of the application and Dapper.

## Constraints

:::caution
Initialize before concurrent queries and treat the effective configuration as read-only afterward.
:::
